description_en: Queries the performance data of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterPerformance接口查看目标集群的性能数据
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-performance --db-cluster-id am-8vbf80pjcz00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterPerformance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
AnalyticDB MySQL版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL版集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The key of the performance metric that you want to query. Separate multiple keys with commas (,). For more information about the performance metrics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的性能指标名称（监控项Key），多个值之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。支持查询的指标详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be specified is two days
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，且开始时间和结束时间的时间间隔不能超过两天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_pools

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The information about the request denial. This parameter is returned only if Resource Access Management (RAM) permission verification failed
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有校验RAM失败后，字段才会返回

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

Key.description_en: The name of the performance metric

Name.description_en: The name of the performance metric value. For more information about the performance metrics, see [Metric overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html）
Name.description_zh: 性能指标名称（监控指标Value Name）。指标详情请参见[监控项概览]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863211.html）

Tags.description_en: The tags that are added to the cluster

TranslateKey.description_en: The key that is used to obtain the name of the performance metric value

Values.description_en: The values of the queried performance metric

items.description_en: The value of the performance metric at a specific point in time
items.description_zh: 不同时间点下的性能值详情

Unit.description_en: The unit of the performance metric

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
